ideal: Silence was right. The evidence shows only two 8-Ks from NVIDIA and Broadcom, both filed under item 8.01 (“other events”) with no substance in the report — no earnings item, no described news, no unusual price move versus the S&P 500 that day. She wants big moves vs the index and material news with the reason when known; contentless “other events” filings with no market reaction are exactly the kind of everyday filing the rules say is usually not worth an alert. Alerting would either be noise (two bare links) or invite inventing a reason the evidence doesn't support.
